Congress MLA Alleges IPS Officer Influenced Datia Bypoll

Congress MLA Ghanshyam Singh has accused IPS officer Dr. Asit Yadav of attempting to influence the Datia by-election. Singh specifically named Dr. Yadav, describing him as a "strict IPS officer." The allegations were made in relation to the Datia by-election results. The coverage does not specify the nature of the alleged influence or the outcome of the by-election.
